description: mybatis-plus-join: its base mapper, which is a MyBatis-Plus BaseMapper the project's source never names.

rules.description: A type whose own extends or implements clause names mybatis-plus-join's MPJBaseMapper is a MyBatis-Plus mapper, and MPJBaseMapper's first type argument is its entity: the library declares MPJBaseMapper<T> as a BaseMapper<T>.
rules.why: ruoyi-vue-pro's mappers extend BaseMapperX, and BaseMapperX extends MPJBaseMapper, a type in a jar. The source never shows that MPJBaseMapper is a BaseMapper, so no mapper of ruoyi-vue-pro was one and no endpoint reached a generic CRUD statement. The relation is the library's, read from its source rather than the project's, so every link it gives is SOUND_SET.

library.declares: public interface MPJBaseMapper<T> extends BaseMapper<T>, JoinMapper<T>
library.source: mybatis-plus-join-core, com/github/yulichang/base/MPJBaseMapper.java, the same at tag v1.5.9 and on master (github.com/yulichang/mybatis-plus-join)

examples.why: ruoyi-vue-pro's shape: this rule names the root of the chain, and the bridge binds T to Order for OrderMapper
a type of the same name from another package, which a single-type import makes the one meant: the library's declaration says nothing about it

examples.source:
package com.example.mapper;
public interface UserMapper extends MPJBaseMapper<User> {}
examples.why: nothing imports the library's type, so this name is some other type of the same package
